sections.markdown:
## D - Accuracy and Verification, Section Twelve Driver Safety

Section D records the accuracy posture for the Section Twelve driver-safety facts. Every knowledge fact is required to trace to its cited handbook page, with the cited page stating the fact in full. Confidence is high across the section because every fact comes from the single pinned handbook edition. No fact needed a lower confidence flag, so no verification debt was opened and no external review was requested. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, or question is reproduced. No time-variable or location-variable fact appears among these driver-safety facts, so nothing required isolation as dynamic knowledge.
